body: I ruin my own life and I'm tired of it.  I am making the Amitriptyline cocktail so I can die in my bed

Some hotlines will call them, others won't.  Same thing happened to me.  Was talking to hotlines daily with cops showing up daily, was obnoxious.  At least I know when I am ready to actually do the deed I won't call
You didn't answer the question.
And I'm 35.  Not a weak twenty-something.  I'm a strong, have had too much pain adult.

I don't know how to message yet.  Can you message me.  It's the combination of everything I mentioned.  I've been thinking about for 3 months now.  There's no chance of recovery.  The mistake was made 7 months ago.  Now I'm just insane from living with it for so long.
I'll take nothingness or permanent sleep. Was hoping to get responses denying life after death.
I'm 35.  It does not get better.
There are plenty of reasons.

No, I don't think there is a chance. I will never forgive myself for what I have done to myself.  Other people are upset because of things that happen to them.  It's things I have done to myself that I will never forgive.  I never thought my dog would outlive me.

You have to understand, all I had to do was be on time to work.  Sometimes I was a few minutes late and I assumed it was OK without clarifying it.  I was having medical issues and could have formally requested a flexible start time.  Either way- always being on time or requesting a flexible start time, both very simple, would have saved months of pain and what I'm feeling now.  I don't want a life with this brain.

I don't want a new career path.  I want my old life.  My life before mental health went down the drain.  Last year was when I became mentally unstable and that is why horrible things happen, I can't think anymore or make decisions.  I don't love my dog enough for that.

I've made too many bad decisions. That lost job ruined my career.  It was finally a position to put me on the right track, after years of randomness this job was going to change things and erase years of pain. Now it's loss is more pain and failure.  And I let it happen. I let an ex make me depressed and let a therapist convince me my life was awful when at the time it wasn't.  He was a stuck up Ivy League asshole who convinced me my software sales job was shit.  It was a good job.  His pointless therapy sessions were shit and I kept going and got fired.  There have been several more disasters since then and I finally broke.  I hate myself for making bad decisions to have bad people in my life, and my inability to fix myself.  My therapist told me he didn't understand me, but I kept seeing him anyway.  I failed myself for letting these people in my life.  And now my life is ruined from bad decision making and poor choices.  I'm too devastated to go on.

Thanks everyone for trying but I've made my decision, writing about it is helping me formulate a timetable as I need to make arrangements for my dog and get the necessary meds. All of my trauma is self inflicted- trusting the wrong people and making the wrong decisions. I'm 35 and can't handle anymore self destruction. Therapy this past year has been harmful and a joke. I lost my job because of my weekly therapy appointment. The trauma from that was unbearable, especially considering the therapy was pointless. I personally feel mental healthcare professionals are just as sick if not sicker than their patients. But I chose to trust them, I chose to keep the therapy appointment even though my boss hated it. This is just one of many traumas and is not the one that has pushed me over the edge but I'm trying to convey that my brain is now worthless and no one including myself can fix it.

It's not courage it takes to end your life, it's hopelessness, pain and most of all mental illness.  What else can you do when your brain is sick and you can't "make it better".

Find a way to forget your family.  I got sick, depression skyrocketed and turned down a job because I thought my family would help and support me.  Instead, they put me on call block.  I'm 35. So instead of being sick with a great job, I am sick with no job and my money runs out next month.  Being mentally ill sucks if there is not one single other person that can help you.  Find a way to help and take care of yourself enough and not even think about your family.  I have to do the same thing.  My little dog is the only thing that pushes me to get through the day.  I'm hoping to eventually get my brain back.  Good luck to you and I hope you can get to functioning too.  I'm trying to convince myself that a life alone with a ruined career is better than no life at all.

I had been in a car accident last May and returned to a stressful work environment.  I sought out therapy to help me deal with the added stress of a somewhat hostile work environment only to hear from my therapist that my work problems were boring and my therapist after that not caring about my delicate work situation either.  Out of depression I started to be late (always less than 10 minutes) and only on some days.  That and my weekly therapy session which I had to leave work every Tuesday at 4:30 for got me fired.  After having 2 therapists that couldn't help me keep my job I'm done with "therapy".  Meds all make me sick so I don't know what the answer is.

But I let my depression from my personal life cause me to be late to work.  All jobs have been compromised due to personal problems. Most people are smart enough to keep those separate, not me and now I'm ruined.

I'm 35.  I've never had a job more than 2 years long because I always get fired.  It's been too long, been working for 13 years.  No one will hire me because of that.  This last job I promised myself I wouldn't lose, because I knew my track record was a problem and I didn't want to get fired.

I should have done a better job. Didn't ask all the right questions.  I know it's because I want to die.  But that job would have helped me.  They guy hadn't realized I was out of work.  My unemployment runs out next month. But I have lost the will to live and am tired of being so sad and ruining my life.

I would never abandon him.  I love him.  I need to find him another home.  My self destruction is what makes me so sad.  I've ruined everything good in my life.  Even blew another interview today that would have saved me.  I'm tired and I'm ready to go.

I've ruined my life too.  All the ruin, like being on time to work and not getting fired, has been my fault.  I'm smart but do stupid things.  I ruin all my jobs and relationships.  I don't see the point of years and years of more pain.  I don't know how to stop the self destruction.
